data.gender_notes: Serena is used as a unisex name in Christian naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: The name Serena is derived from the Latin word 'serenus', meaning calm, tranquil, and serene. In Roman mythology, Serena was the goddess of calmness, peace, and prosperity. In Christian tradition, the name Serena is associated with inner peace, calmness, and serenity. The name Serena carries the meaning “calm, tranquil” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Latin. Parents who choose Serena usually hope their child will grow to embody calm, tranquil and live with faith, good character and purpose.

data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Serena total 8, giving a life-path number of 8. Number 8 is linked with Saturn and with the qualities of ambition, resilience and material success.

data.cultural_impact: The name Serena has been popular in various cultures throughout history. It has been used as a feminine given name in the Western world since the Middle Ages and has especially gained popularity in the 20th and 21st centuries due to famous bearers such as tennis champion Serena Williams. The name has also been used in literature, music, and art, symbolizing beauty, strength, and grace.
data.spiritual_significance: For Christians, the name Serena holds a deep spiritual significance as it represents inner peace, calmness, and serenity, which are qualities that are highly valued in the Christian faith. The name can serve as a reminder to seek inner stillness and peace in the midst of a busy and often chaotic world. Additionally, Serena can be seen as a reflection of the peace and tranquility that comes from having a close relationship with God, providing a sense of comfort and assurance in times of uncertainty. Ultimately, the name Serena can inspire individuals to cultivate a deeper and more meaningful spiritual life, drawing them closer to the love and grace of God.
data.spiritual_symbolism: Serena in Christianity symbolizes the gentle and calming presence of God, bringing peace and tranquility in times of turmoil. It also represents the serene strength of the Virgin Mary, guiding and protecting her children through life's challenges.
